items.summary: Scoping landed in notes.md `## F1 reward shaping — scoping (2026-05-14)`. Awaiting human go/no-go on whether to implement shaping signals before launching the experiment — this is NOT a launch-and-watch decision like R15.S1/S2 were; code lands first.
